mapper.sql: SELECT id, organization_id, term_id, official_course_id, code, name, class_kind, status FROM edu_teaching_class
mapper.select:
AND name LIKE concat('%', #{name}, '%') AND code LIKE concat('%', #{code}, '%') AND status = #{status}
ORDER BY id DESC

SELECT DISTINCT tc.id, tc.organization_id, tc.term_id, tc.official_course_id, tc.code, tc.name, tc.class_kind, tc.status FROM edu_teaching_class tc INNER JOIN edu_class_teacher ct ON tc.id = ct.teaching_class_id WHERE ct.user_id = #{userId} AND ct.valid_to IS NULL ORDER BY tc.id DESC

SELECT DISTINCT tc.id, tc.organization_id, tc.term_id, tc.official_course_id, tc.code, tc.name, tc.class_kind, tc.status FROM edu_teaching_class tc INNER JOIN edu_class_student cs ON tc.id = cs.teaching_class_id WHERE cs.user_id = #{userId} AND cs.left_at IS NULL ORDER BY tc.id DESC
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO edu_teaching_class(organization_id, term_id, official_course_id, code, name, class_kind, status) VALUES (#{organizationId}, #{termId}, #{officialCourseId}, #{code}, #{name}, #{classKind}, #{status})
